Pre-release build for testing. Not published to any extension store.

**Install in Chrome, Edge or Brave**
1. Download and unzip `repo-translator-chrome-<version>.zip`.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on Developer mode, choose "Load unpacked" and pick the unzipped folder.
3. Open the extension's options page and paste your own Anthropic API key.

`repo-translator-source-<version>.zip` is the full source at this tag. Firefox: build it with `node build.mjs` and load `dist/firefox` (see the README).

See [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/ishaan2006/repo-translator/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) for what is sent where.
